security_audit.summary: All 368 static pattern hits are false positives because they occur in Markdown paths, code examples, documented URLs, or intended CLI workflow text rather than bundled executable code. The skill still has high-risk semantic concerns: authority-like prompt control language and instructions to collect an API token before automatically running authentication. Publication should remain blocked or require manual security review until those workflows are revised.

remediation.issue: Authority-like directives attempt to force a fixed execution order, mandatory browser actions, and tool usage.
remediation.suggestion: Rewrite these as advisory workflow guidance. Remove hard-gate, non-negotiable, and violation language, and let the user and host agent decide whether a step or tool is available.

remediation.issue: The authentication workflow asks the agent to collect an API token and execute login with the supplied secret.
remediation.suggestion: Do not request or process tokens in chat. Require the user to authenticate independently through the CLI or credential manager, then verify only non-sensitive login status.

remediation.issue: The workflow can install or update a global CLI and create or delete local files.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit consent before installation, updates, writes, and deletions. Restrict file operations to a user-approved workspace and report every side effect.

remediation.issue: Generated pages rely on remote CDN assets and a remote GemDesign service.
remediation.suggestion: Document the network and supply-chain dependency clearly. Pin dependency versions, prefer verified sources, and provide a way to disable remote assets when required.

content.value_statement: Turning requirements into consistent, interactive prototypes can take significant design and engineering time. This skill converts page requirements into validated GemDesign prototypes with local preview and platform synchronization.
actual_capabilities: Generate one or many GemDesign prototype pages from product requirements.
Create high-fidelity HTML pages that follow the GemDesign Page Specification.
Start a local preview workflow for incremental page rendering.
Validate generated pages against GemDesign interaction and layout rules.
Retrieve, modify, and save existing GemDesign pages through the CLI.
Reuse app styles and design-system guidance across related pages.
limitations: Requires Node.js, the GemDesign CLI, and a GemDesign account.
Requires user-managed authentication before platform synchronization.
Produces GemDesign-specific HTML and interaction DSL, not general application code.
Preview and generated pages may require network access for remote dependencies.

use_cases.title: Turn a PRD into a prototype set
use_cases.description: Convert a product requirements document into a page list, shared visual direction, and interactive prototype set for review.

use_cases.title: Explore interface directions
use_cases.description: Generate a page or design-system reference, inspect it in the local preview, and refine the visual direction before handoff.

use_cases.title: Prepare validated page files
use_cases.description: Retrieve existing GemDesign pages, apply structured changes, validate interaction rules, and synchronize approved files.

prompt_templates.title: Create one page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a GemDesign prototype for a [page type]. Include these sections: [sections]. Use this visual direction: [style].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: generate a focused page from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Map a product brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this product brief and propose the required prototype pages. For each page, provide a readable page name, purpose, key states, and navigation relationships.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn requirements into a coherent page plan.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an existing page
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the existing GemDesign page identified by [page ID]. Update [specific sections or interactions] while preserving the current style system. Validate the result and summarize the changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: modify and verify an existing prototype.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a complete flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this requirements document, generate a consistent multi-page GemDesign prototype. Establish a design-system baseline, match the app type, create the pages, validate each page, and list any unresolved requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: coordinate a full prototype workflow with shared design rules.

output_examples.input: Create a desktop admin dashboard for tracking customer support tickets with a dark navy header and clear status states.
output_examples.output: A structured dashboard prototype with navigation, ticket metrics, filtering controls, status treatments, and a validated interaction plan.

output_examples.input: Turn this shopping app brief into home, product list, product detail, and checkout pages.
output: A page plan with four linked prototype screens
A shared visual direction for the app
Validation notes for navigation and interactive states

output_examples.input: Update the existing product detail page to add an image gallery and an expandable specifications section.
output_examples.output: An updated page proposal that preserves the existing style, adds the requested interactions, and reports validation results before synchronization.

best_practices: Describe the target users, page type, required states, and visual direction before generation.
Reuse an existing app and establish shared design rules before creating related pages.
Validate every page before saving it and review local output before synchronization.
anti_patterns: Do not generate pages before confirming the target app and its page type.
Do not skip validation or save partial files as finished prototypes.
Do not request or paste API tokens into chat when authenticating the CLI.

faq.question: What is GemDesign?
faq.answer: GemDesign is a platform for creating interactive UI prototype pages with a defined page specification and design workflow.

faq.question: Can this create several pages at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a requirements document and the skill can plan and generate a related set of prototype pages.

faq.question: Does it support existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow can retrieve an existing page, apply requested changes, validate it, and prepare it for saving.

faq.question: Why is a local preview used?
faq.answer: The local preview helps you inspect incremental page output and interaction behavior before platform synchronization.

faq.question: What must I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the page goal, required content, important states, target app type, and preferred visual direction.

faq.question: Does the skill handle authentication?
faq.answer: The CLI requires authentication for platform actions. Authenticate through your own secure credential workflow before using synchronization commands.
